title: Support Claude Code on Linux distributions with coreutils < 8.30
body:
When running Claude Code on Linux distributions with `coreutils` versions < 8.30, it fails with the following output:
```
% claude
/usr/bin/env: invalid option -- 'S'
Try '/usr/bin/env --help' for more information.
```

The 8.30 release of `coreutils` ([release notes](https://lists.gnu.org/archive/html/coreutils/2018-07/msg00001.html)) added the `-S` option to `env`. Amazon Linux 2 is one example of a system with a `coreutils` version < 8.30: [it uses coreutils version 8.22](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/linux/al2023/ug/amzn2-al2023-ami.html). This is the OS I've verified the problem on.

https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/67 is likely related to this, but does not specify anything about the OS. https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/248 is also similar.

The ask here is to make Claude Code compatible with older distributions of Linux with `coreutils` < 8.30
author: jackrein
